entities.summary: Francisco Ramón de Jesús Aguilar Barquero was a Costa Rican lawyer and politician who served as the 23rd President of Costa Rica from 1919 to 1920. A member of the Republican Party, his administration is noted for overseeing the country’s transition back to constitutional governance following the dictatorship of the Tinoco brothers.
